target_gate: Phase 7 runtime streaming event transport and interrupt/human-approval state

score_delta.rationale: Runtime events now have a persisted SSE transport, and interrupt/resume/human-approval state is projected from RuntimeStateStore session_events through operator views, API routes, tests, and the dashboard runtime panel. This closes the state/transport proof slice but does not implement assistant/configuration parity, background/cron runs, approval action execution, A2A strict readiness, or remaining memory/provider gates.

implemented: Added RuntimePlatformViews.runtime_interrupts(), deriving control events from canonical session_events instead of a new store.
Added FastAPI GET /api/runtime/events/stream for server-sent persisted runtime events with filters and finite max_events test support.
Added FastAPI GET /api/runtime/interrupts for interrupt, resume, and human-approval state snapshots.
Extended runtime graph API tests to seed interrupt_requested and human_approval_granted runtime events and prove API/operator/SSE readback.
Added dashboard RuntimeInterruptsSnapshot types, fetchRuntimeInterrupts(), and runtimeEventsStreamPath().
Extended useRuntimeControlPlane() and /dashboard/runtime to show pending interrupt, human approval, approved, resumed, and recent control-event state.
